verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser runs AI browser agents (HyperAgent and hosted agents), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence, however, documents only Hyperbrowser's own MCP server, which exposes its scraping, extraction and crawling tools to other AI clients. That is the opposite, server-side role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows the product connecting to user-supplied MCP servers or using their tools.
